configs.description: CRS309-1G-8S+IN - eight SFP+ cages, one 10/100/1000 port with PoE in and the DE-9 console, passively cooled. The box holds a 24 V 1.2 A adapter, a screw kit and rack ears.

gaps.note: The brochure and the product page give a maximum power consumption of 23 W (17 W without attachments); the quick guide says the consumption under maximum load is up to 17 W. 23 W is carried as the maximum and 17 W as the figure without attachments.

built-in-power-and-fans.note: The unit is powered by the DC jack or by PoE in on Ethernet 1, with a 24 V 1.2 A adapter in the box; no supply is built in, so there are no bays. The product page lists the cooling as passive and the brochure says the enclosure acts as a heatsink, so no fan is drawn; the finned heatsink on the rear is the cooling. The two inputs work in fail-over (quick guide: the input with the higher voltage is the main source).

buttons.note: One round button printed RESET (quick guide: the reset button, for reset and Netinstall).

chassis.note: 272 x 44 x 191 from the brochure and the product page, which agree; no drawing is held. The body is narrower than the rack, and the rack ears supplied carry it to the rack face (photographs 1732 and 1733).

console.note: The brochure and the product page call the serial port RS232 and the quick guide an RS-232 serial port at 115200 bit/s. The metal shows a nine-pin D-sub connector with jackscrews under the printed CONSOLE, so it is drawn with the library's DE-9 receptacle. Its role is rs232 and not console: the DCIM exporter's device path exports no DE-9 as a console port, so the export carries no console port for it.

datasheet.note: The brochure is MikroTik's datasheet for the model: product code CRS309-1G-8S+IN, CPU 98DX8208 800 MHz dual core, 512 MB RAM, 16 MB flash, 272 x 191 x 44 mm, -40 to +70 C tested, one 10/100/1000 port, eight SFP+ ports, serial port RS232, PoE in (passive and 802.3af/at), 12 - 57 V on the DC jack and 18 - 57 V on PoE in, one DC jack, 23 W maximum and 17 W without attachments, an included 24 V 1.2 A adapter, a screw kit and rack ears. The brochure says "special rackmount ears" are provided.

dc-in-rating.note: The rear prints "DC 12-57 V" above the jack (photograph 1731): the `input-voltage` of the dc-in jack, carried as printed. The brochure's and the quick guide's included 24 V 1.2 A adapter gives the `current-max-a`. The quick guide states the jack as 5.5 mm outside, 2 mm inside, pin positive (female); that size is not part of the library's one nominal dc-barrel and is carried here. The quick guide's 11-57 V is a conflict declared in the gaps.

dc-input.note: The rear prints "DC 12-57 V" above the jack and a polarity symbol under it (photograph 1731). The brochure and the product page list 12 - 57 V on the DC jack; the quick guide says it accepts 11-57 V. The legend is drawn as printed, the polarity symbol sits clear of the jack part's footprint (3.6 mm lower than the photograph shows it), and the quick guide's figure is declared a conflict. The jack is the placed common/dc-barrel (dc-in), its bore positioned on the bore of photograph 1731.

ears.note: Rack ears are in the box (brochure: special rackmount ears are provided; product page: rack ears; quick guide: the mounting kit 1U RCB 190 mm, fitted to both sides with four screws). Photographs 1732 and 1733 show the ear bracket bolted to the side wall flush with the face, long enough to reach the rack face, with the body at one side of the opening. The generic ear is drawn symmetrically and does not show that. No drawing is held, so no distance behind the face is given. The K-37 fastening set is a screw set and not a rack kit, so no kit is listed. The ears are not drawn.

earth.note: The rear carries an earthing stud with a wing nut under an earth symbol (photograph 1731). common/ground-stud draws a hex nut and a lug seat the stud does not have, so the stud is chassis art and the symbol is placed; the gap earth-stud-part asks for a wing-nut stud part.

front-layout.note: estimated - read off photograph 1730 as described under gate-1. Eight SFP+ cages, the first centred at 31.3 mm, 19.76 mm apart, top at 27.1 mm; each has its ACT lamp 5.05 mm left and its 10G lamp 4.55 mm right of its centre, 23.0 mm down, with the legends ACT and 10G above them and SFP+ n under the cage. The POE/BOOT jack is centred at 194.8 mm and the DE-9 CONSOLE connector at 222.6 mm. The RESET button is at 243.2 mm, with the USER and PWR lamps at 251 mm. The hexagon vent band over the cages is drawn as the photograph shows it.

gate-1.note: estimated - the face of photograph 1730 is 3480 px wide for the printed 272 mm (12.79 px per mm) and 523 px tall for the printed 44 mm (11.89 px per mm), 0.93 of the horizontal scale, so the camera looks down and the photograph is not orthographic. Every x on the front is taken at 12.79 px per mm from the body's left edge and every y at 11.89 px per mm from the face's top edge; the y values are estimated, good to about 1 mm. The eight cage openings read a pitch of 252.7 px, 19.76 mm, uniform to 0.2 mm.

lamps.note: The quick guide's LED section says the power LED is lit when the router is powered from the DC jack or PoE, the user LED can be configured from RouterOS, and the port LEDs indicate the individual Ethernet and SFP port activity. The USER and PWR lamps are given the lit colours photograph 1730 shows (green and blue). Nothing held says what ACT and 10G mean as colours or states, so that is a gap.

poe-in.note: The Ethernet port (Ether 1, printed POE/BOOT) accepts 802.3af/at and passive PoE power input, 18 - 57 V DC (quick guide; brochure: 18 - 57 V on PoE in). The face marks the port only with its printed name, POE/BOOT: no band or lamp, so none is drawn. The port carries a poe attr.

port-numbering.note: The metal prints SFP+ 1 to SFP+ 8 left to right under the cages, POE/BOOT under the Ethernet jack and CONSOLE under the DE-9 (photograph 1730). The block diagram names the cages SFP+ 1 to 8 and the management port Ether 1.

rear-layout.note: estimated - read off photograph 1731, which looks down on the rear, so x is taken at 11.96 px per mm across the 272 mm width and y at 10.9 px per mm from the wall's top, good to about 2 mm. The cable-restraint slot is at 8.1 to 40.3 mm, the DC jack's bore at 65.8 mm, the heatsink fin ends from 85.0 to 257.7 mm (about 24 fins on a 7.1 mm pitch) and the earthing stud at 260 mm. Two of the rear's crosshead screws are drawn.
